source: Antoine equation for water, log10(P[mmHg]) = A - B / (C + T[°C]); standard coefficients (1-100 °C range). Matches the SME's calculated table (docs/science/round2-review.md §1.1: 0.7 kPa -> 2 °C, 5 kPa -> 33 °C). Below the triple point (0.611657 kPa) there is no liquid phase, so no boiling point.
